paper_title: Compact Attention: Exploiting Structured Spatio-Temporal Sparsity for Fast Video Generation

baseline_full_attention.description: Full attention computation where n = sequence_length, d = hidden_dimension

proposed_compact_attention.description: Sparse attention with sparsity_ratio + mask lookup overhead k

improved_method.computation: [n, d, n] * adaptive_sparsity + [n, d, k] + [b, d, b]
improved_method.description: Adaptive sparsity with block-wise processing and dynamic thresholding

gaps_and_limitations.gap: Fixed recall and cost thresholds may compromise visual fidelity
gaps_and_limitations.description: The auto-search strategy uses static thresholds (τ=0.9, λ=0.011/0.04) which may not adapt to content complexity
Cannot adapt to dynamic content changes during generation, requires pre-computed masks
Method designed for single-GPU setups, no multi-GPU scaling considered

gaps_and_limitations.gap: No consideration of attention head interactions
gaps_and_limitations.description: Treats attention heads independently, missing potential cross-head optimization opportunities
Frame-group-wise patterns use coarse temporal grouping, may miss fine-grained temporal dependencies

improvements.title: Adaptive Thresholding System
improvements.description: Dynamic recall and cost thresholds based on content complexity and noise levels

implementation.approach: Content-aware threshold adjustment using statistical measures of attention entropy
implementation.algorithm: Gradient-based threshold optimization during denoising process

innovation_points: First adaptive thresholding for sparse attention in video generation
Content complexity measurement via attention statistics

improvements.title: Online Mask Refinement
improvements.description: Lightweight online mask adjustment to complement offline pre-computation

implementation.approach: Incremental mask updates using low-rank approximations
implementation.algorithm: SVD-based mask refinement with O(n log n) complexity

expected_improvement.runtime_change: [n, d, n] * sparsity + [n, d, k] + [n, r, n] where r << d

innovation_points: First online refinement for pre-computed sparse attention masks
Low-rank approximation for efficient mask updates
Residual-based adjustment preserving critical attention paths

improvements.title: Multi-GPU Distributed Sparsity
improvements.description: Scalable sparsity patterns across multiple GPUs with communication optimization

implementation.approach: Distributed tile processing with hierarchical sparsity

architecture.communication: Sparse gradient exchange using top-k selection

expected_improvement.runtime_change: [n/p, d, n] * sparsity + [n/p, d, k] + [n, d, c] where p=GPUs, c=communication

innovation_points: First distributed sparse attention for video generation

improvements.title: Cross-Head Attention Optimization
improvements.description: Joint optimization across attention heads exploiting head correlations

implementation.approach: Shared sparsity patterns with head-specific refinements
implementation.algorithm: Multi-head attention clustering with shared basis
methodology: Head correlation analysis via attention similarity

expected_improvement.runtime_change: [h, n, d, n] * (sparsity + 0.1) + [h, n, d, s] where h=heads, s=shared_patterns

innovation_points: First cross-head sparsity optimization in video transformers
Attention head clustering for pattern sharing

improvements.title: Fine-Grained Temporal Modeling
improvements.description: Sub-frame temporal patterns with micro-temporal adaptation

implementation.approach: Hierarchical temporal modeling with multiple granularities
implementation.algorithm: Multi-resolution temporal attention with adaptive pooling

paper_innovations.title: Structured Sparsity Discovery
paper_innovations.description: First systematic identification of hierarchical spatio-temporal patterns in video diffusion transformers
paper_innovations.novelty: Discovered local, cross-shaped, and global spatial patterns plus time-variant/invariant temporal patterns
paper_innovations.impact: Enables principled sparse attention design for video generation

paper_innovations.title: Tile-Based Deformable Patterns
paper_innovations.description: Adaptive tile grouping that respects 3D video structure while maintaining hardware efficiency
paper_innovations.novelty: Dynamic tile combinations approximating diverse attention modes

paper_innovations.title: Offline Auto-Search Algorithm
paper_innovations.description: Training-free mask optimization with dual threshold system
paper_innovations.novelty: Decouples pattern discovery from runtime execution
paper_innovations.impact: Eliminates runtime overhead while preserving fidelity

proposed_improvements.title: Adaptive Thresholding
proposed_improvements.description: Dynamic thresholds based on content complexity and noise levels
proposed_improvements.novelty: First content-aware sparsity control in video generation

proposed_improvements.title: Online Refinement
proposed_improvements.description: Real-time mask adjustment using low-rank approximations
proposed_improvements.novelty: First online sparse mask refinement for pre-computed patterns
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: [n, d, n] * sparsity + [n, d, k] + [n, r, n]

proposed_improvements.title: Multi-GPU Scaling
proposed_improvements.description: Distributed sparse attention with communication optimization
proposed_improvements.novelty: First distributed implementation of sparse video attention
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: [n/p, d, n] * sparsity + [n/p, d, k] + [n, d, c]

proposed_multi_gpu.communication_volume: O(n * sparsity / p) where p = number of GPUs
